newsitem.title: CANADA: BANK OF CANADA 91-DAY T-BILL YIELDS AVG 3.144 PCT.
newsitem.headline: BANK OF CANADA 91-DAY T-BILL YIELDS AVG 3.144 PCT.

text.p: The Bank of Canada said the average yield at this week's auction of C$2.2 billion of 91-day Government of Canada treasury bills due November 13 was 3.144 percent, down from 3.323 percent last week.

The average yield on C$1.1 billion of 182-day T-bills due February 12, 1998 was 3.686 percent, down from 3.711 percent last week, and on C$1.0 billion of 357-day T-bills due August 6, 1998 was 3.886 percent, down from 4.193 percent.
The Bank bought C$575 million three-month, C$125 million six-month and C$25 million one-year bills. It holds C$750 million of C$4.6 billion bills due August 21. (Details follow)
